description: Wasserversorgungsnetz Stadtwerke Husum Netz GmbH is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. The water supply network comprises data on drinking water distribution, transport networks and raw water pipes for the supply area of Stadtwerke Husum Netz GmbH in the municipality of Husum and the municipality of Mildstedt. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Water supply network Stadtwerke Husum Netz GmbH" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2017-09-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
